text:
Maya (Sales): Quick handover for Nebula Health — deal closed today. 50-seat expansion, SSO + private deployment requested. Renewal in ~11 months; they want SLA + HIPAA. Notes: https://redwood.example.com/deals/nebula-4521

Jordan (CS): Thanks Maya — I'll take lead. Can you drop a short matrix of current PoC infra and the top 3 success metrics we should track?

Maya (Sales): Sure — bullets: hosted API today, ~120 req/min average, bursts to ~400 req/min during batch ingest. Using embeddings for semantic search, retention ~30 days. Top pains: latency spikes during ingest windows, cost sensitivity. Main contact: Ravi (CTO).

Jordan (CS): Assigned to me. I'll schedule a kickoff with Ravi. Need SSO/SCIM details + data residency constraints. @Diego (Eng) — can you advise on Private deployment timeline vs Dedicated capacity?

Diego (Eng): We can do Dedicated reserved capacity in ~3 weeks (non-VPC). VPC/private deployment ~6-8 weeks depending on infra review. Need exact qps and peak seq len. Example of config we need:
```
model: redwood-llama-2-7b
qps: 120
max_seq: 2048
burst: 400
retention_days: 30
```

Priya (Support): I'll open the onboarding ticket and prep the template (SSO steps, test plan, escalation flow). Jordan — please share the runbook and checklist when you have it. I'll own triage for first 30 days.

Jordan (CS): Drafting runbook now; it will include onboarding playbook, SLAs, and eng escalation path. @Oncall Bot please note potential increased alerts during rollout window.

Oncall Bot: Eng oncall rotation acknowledged. When rollout starts, create incident channel: #release-nebula (auto).

Maya (Sales): FYI they asked about renewal pricing flexibility — flagged medium risk. Sales recommends a joint success SLA trial for 6 months to reduce churn risk. Jordan, please assign renewal risk and exec sponsor.

Jordan (CS): Logged in tracker: renewal_risk=medium; exec_sponsor=Leah (Customer Success Director). Next steps (owners):
- Jordan: schedule kickoff + agenda (owner: Jordan)
- Diego: estimate infra lead time + resource needs (owner: Diego)
- Priya: create support ticket + onboarding checklist (owner: Priya)
- Maya: intro email to Ravi + Leah, cc Jordan (owner: Maya)
I will set invites by EOD tomorrow.

Diego (Eng): Also need expected peak embedding size (MB) and whether they require long-term embedding retention — affects cache and disk sizing.

Jordan (CS): Noted. Maya — can Ravi share retention policy / PII handling questions so we can prep compliance checklist?

Maya (Sales): Intro email sent to Ravi, cc'd Leah and Jordan. Sales notes link: https://redwood.example.com/deals/nebula-4521

Priya (Support): Created ticket #CS-4922 with onboarding steps; assigned to Jordan. Template includes SSO, data residency, compliance checklist, and a 30-day monitoring plan.

Jordan (CS): Great — I'll post the kickoff agenda in this thread and close the handover once onboarding kicks off. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
